channel.title: Bs2FoB
channel.description: Established footholds — each one becomes the next starting point

item.title: Reordering the Lists
item.description: The Writing and Verse tabs now list from the first piece. The earlier pieces weigh far more than the later ones.

item.title: Renumbering, and a Few Other Things
item.description: Cognitive Axioms numbering is now ##_#. And the question of identity and similarity that stayed with me through the 04 set.

item.title: Tensors and JSON
item.description: In an axis coordinate system, only the coordinates are in focus. JSON is the container that pairs them with axis names and carries them.

item.title: Identity Is a Matter of Scale
item.description: Mercury's orbit, manufacturing tolerances, yesterday's self. Being the same means the difference falls below the scale.

item.title: The Absence of Transformation
item.description: Real cognitive computation has no transformation. What can't be carried over gets borrowed.

item.title: Axis Coordinate Systems
item.description: The basic component of cognitive computation is the axis coordinate system: number of axes, axis names, units, coordinates.

item.title: Why Billing Needs a Fixed Basis
item.description: 1% used. Of what? One gauge with no denominator, and why AI services need a billing basis that never changes.

item.title: Up to 007 Without Much Thought
item.description: What began with the intelligence trichotomy ran on to 007. The active living cognizer is on hold for now.

item.title: The Default Settings of the Living Cognizer
item.description: There is no flawless agent. Ambiguity and anxiety are the defaults of the living cognizer.

item.title: The Emergence of the Living Cognizer
item.description: From the Cambrian explosion to writing: lifeforms that acquired a cognitive system for handling representations.

item.title: The Emergence of Lifeforms
item.description: Entropy and time, attractors and Hamilton, and how local order emerged as lifeforms: devices that accelerate dissipation.

item.title: The Intelligence Trichotomy
item.description: HI · SI · PI. Splitting what the word intelligence lumps together into three.

item.title: The Pragmatic Maxim and Information Theory
item.description: How to judge what abduction opens: Peirce's maxim and Shannon's information.

item.title: Abduction
item.description: Only abduction opens a hypothesis space. Deduction and induction work inside it.

item.title: Particle Physics and the Established Foothold
item.description: Dr. Park Moon-ho's lecture, 33:50 to 1:19:34. From the discovery of the nucleus to the Copenhagen institute: each foothold secured, then used as the next starting point.

item.title: AI Handling Devices
item.description: The devices that steer the AI in Claude Code, ordered by how hard they bind.

item.title: Delegate Deterministic Operations to External Tools
item.description: One wall an LLM can never climb: answering deterministic operations head-on with nothing but probabilistic inference.

item.title: A Word About Claymore
item.description: How far do you open it? One gauge, and from there the template that charges cannibalism as the price — where it started and how far it spread.

item.title: A Verse Tab
item.description: A Verse tab went in between Log and Writing. Four digits, so 9999 slots.

item.title: Reworking the Tabs
item.description: Review became Snap, and a Lexicon tab went in.

item.title: Rewriting 001, and a few settings
item.description: The tone got reset and the fertilizer section went in. Justified text, mobile layout, and the numbering scheme are now decided.

item.title: What the next stretch looks like
item.description: Still settling the setup. For a while the work is splitting older drafts into short pieces and putting them up.

item.title: Established Foothold
item.description: Finishing is not perfecting. A procedure for deciding what unit of work counts as done.
